title: Zosimus' Greek alchemical works (Authentic Memoirs; On the Letter Omega; Final Quittance); RU: Зосима Панополитанский, «Подлинные записки», «О букве омега»
author: Zosimus of Panopolis
edition: Berthelot & Ruelle, Collection des anciens alchimistes grecs, 1887–88 (Greek and French; public domain). Mertens, Budé 1995 (Mémoires authentiques; critical).
ru_evidence: ru.wikipedia «Зосима Панополитанский» cites only histories of chemistry, no translation; none found elsewhere.
en_evidence: en.wikipedia: 'English translations remain elusive'; only excerpts (Mead's Omega excerpt; the Visions). Abt's English versions translate Arabic works.
other_translations: French: Berthelot–Ruelle 1888 (everything known at the time); Mertens 1995 (Budé).
value: The first named alchemist, foundational for the history of chemistry, Gnosticism, Hermetism and Egyptian temple technology; his dream-visions are major religious-literary texts. Broad humanities appeal.
ai_feasibility: low-medium: allegorical, corrupt, symbolic-technical vocabulary. Needs conservative literal translation, explicit uncertainty markers and reviewer debate.
pilot_unit: On the Letter Omega (Mertens, Mém. I) plus Final Quittance, est. 4–5k words
